meaning.upright: A fresh start beckons; step forward with an open heart and light luggage.
meaning.reversed: Look before you leap — or stop refusing to leap at all.

meaning.upright: You have every tool you need; intention becomes reality.
meaning.reversed: Skill misused or unused; ask who is being fooled.

meaning.upright: The answer is already known to you; listen beneath the noise.
meaning.reversed: You are ignoring what you know; the veil now hides you from yourself.

meaning.upright: Growth and generosity; something is ready to flourish.
meaning.reversed: Nurture yourself before the garden; blocked creativity needs rest.

meaning.upright: Order and steady leadership; build the frame that holds the picture.
meaning.reversed: Control tightens into rigidity; authority without warmth.

meaning.upright: Wisdom handed down — a teacher, an institution, a shared value.
meaning.reversed: Question the rules; your own path may diverge from the taught one.

meaning.upright: A meaningful union or a choice of the heart; values in alignment.
meaning.reversed: Values out of step; a choice avoided or a bond strained.

meaning.upright: Will drives opposing forces forward together; victory through focus.
meaning.reversed: The reins slip; ambition scatters without direction.

meaning.upright: Quiet strength tames the lion; courage is gentle and patient.
meaning.reversed: Doubt saps resolve; be gentle with yourself first.

meaning.upright: Step back and carry your own light; wisdom is found in quiet.
meaning.reversed: Solitude curdles into isolation; return when the lamp is lit.

meaning.upright: The wheel turns; change arrives whether or not it was invited.
meaning.reversed: Resistance to the turning; a cycle breaks or repeats.

meaning.upright: Cause meets effect; act with clarity and accept the balance.
meaning.reversed: Accountability avoided; a scale tipped by dishonesty.

meaning.upright: Let go and hang a while; the world looks different upside down.
meaning.reversed: Stalling disguised as patience; a sacrifice no one asked for.

meaning.upright: Something ends so something can begin; transformation, not doom.
meaning.reversed: Clinging to what has passed; change delayed is not change denied.

meaning.upright: Blend opposites with patience; the middle path is alchemy.
meaning.reversed: Excess in one direction; recalibrate the mixture.

meaning.upright: Chains that are looser than they look; name the attachment.
meaning.reversed: The chains fall; freedom through awareness.

meaning.upright: Lightning strikes what was built on sand; the truth clears the ground.
meaning.reversed: A collapse averted or postponed; do not rebuild on the same fault.

meaning.upright: After the storm, a clear sky; hope quietly refills the well.
meaning.reversed: Hope feels far; reconnect with what once inspired you.

meaning.upright: Not everything is as it seems; walk carefully, by intuition.
meaning.reversed: The fog lifts; fears prove smaller in the light.

meaning.upright: Warmth, clarity, and simple joy; success in the open.
meaning.reversed: A cloud crosses the sun; joy dimmed but not gone.

meaning.upright: A call to rise and answer; renewal through honest reckoning.
meaning.reversed: The call goes unanswered; judge yourself less harshly.

meaning.upright: A cycle completes; wholeness and well-earned celebration.
meaning.reversed: Nearly there; the last step remains unfinished.

meaning.upright: A spark of inspiration wants to become action; say yes to the idea that excites you.
meaning.reversed: The spark flickers; a plan needs direction before it can catch.

meaning.upright: You stand at the threshold with the world in your hand; choose the horizon you will walk toward.
meaning.reversed: Fear of the unknown keeps the map folded; indecision is itself a choice.

meaning.upright: Ships you sent out are returning; your foresight begins to pay off.
meaning.reversed: Delays test your patience; check whether the plan still fits the goal.

meaning.upright: Celebration and belonging; a foundation strong enough to dance upon.
meaning.reversed: The ground shifts beneath a gathering; seek stability before celebration.

meaning.upright: Sparks fly as wills collide; friction can sharpen or scatter.
meaning.reversed: The struggle is easing — or being avoided; ask which.

meaning.upright: Recognition arrives; a hard-won victory is seen by others.
meaning.reversed: Applause feels hollow or absent; measure success by your own standard.

meaning.upright: You hold the high ground; stand firm for what you have built.
meaning.reversed: Exhaustion whispers surrender; choose your battles more carefully.

meaning.upright: Things move quickly now; messages and momentum are in the air.
meaning.reversed: Energy scatters and news is delayed; slow down to aim.

meaning.upright: Weary but unbroken; one more effort guards what matters.
meaning.reversed: Suspicion and fatigue wear thin; not every shadow is an enemy.

meaning.upright: You carry a heavy load toward a near goal; it is almost time to set it down.
meaning.reversed: Release what is not yours to carry; ask for help.

meaning.upright: A bright messenger of new enthusiasm; explore before you commit.
meaning.reversed: Excitement without follow-through; find your direction first.

meaning.upright: Passion charges forward; adventure calls and you answer.
meaning.reversed: Haste and impulsiveness risk burning out; temper fire with patience.

meaning.upright: Warm, magnetic confidence; you draw others by being fully yourself.
meaning.reversed: Insecurity hides behind demands; return to what genuinely lights you up.

meaning.upright: A visionary leader who acts boldly; your example moves others.
meaning.reversed: Impatience and high expectations can scorch; lead with warmth, not fire.

meaning.upright: A vessel overflows with new feeling; love or creativity begins.
meaning.reversed: Feelings are held back or the well runs dry; let something in.

meaning.upright: Two hearts meet as equals; a bond is formed or renewed.
meaning.reversed: Imbalance strains a partnership; honest words restore the flow.

meaning.upright: Friends gather; joy is multiplied when shared.
meaning.reversed: Too much of a good thing, or standing outside the circle; find your true company.

meaning.upright: Offered a new cup, you look away; boredom hides an opportunity.
meaning.reversed: You stir from apathy and reach for what is offered.

meaning.upright: Grief over what was spilled — yet two cups still stand behind you.
meaning.reversed: Acceptance loosens the knot; forgiveness lets you turn around.

meaning.upright: Sweet memories and simple kindness return to you.
meaning.reversed: The past holds you too tightly; take its lessons and leave the rest.

meaning.upright: Many visions float before you; not all of them are real.
meaning.reversed: The fog lifts and the true choice becomes clear.

meaning.upright: You leave what once satisfied to seek something deeper.
meaning.reversed: Fear of leaving keeps you circling; drift or decide.

meaning.upright: Contentment and wishes granted; savour what you have.
meaning.reversed: Satisfaction feels thin; ask what you truly wish for.

meaning.upright: Harmony at home and heart; a rainbow of lasting happiness.
meaning.reversed: A picture of happiness with cracks; realign values with loved ones.

meaning.upright: A curious message from the heart; a creative or intuitive nudge.
meaning.reversed: Doubt blocks the wellspring; take your feelings seriously.

meaning.upright: A romantic invitation approaches, charming and sincere.
meaning.reversed: Moodiness or unrealistic promises; test the offer against reality.

meaning.upright: Deep compassion and calm intuition; you hold space for others.
meaning.reversed: Emotional overwhelm or self-neglect; refill your own cup.

meaning.upright: Mastery of feeling; wise, generous, and steady in the storm.
meaning.reversed: Emotions are managed rather than felt; beware cold manipulation.

meaning.upright: A breakthrough of clarity cuts through confusion; truth arrives.
meaning.reversed: Thoughts tangle; a sharp idea used carelessly does harm.

meaning.upright: A stalemate held by choice; you have shut your eyes in order to decide.
meaning.reversed: The blindfold slips; information floods in and a choice forms.

meaning.upright: Sorrow pierces the heart; a painful truth is spoken.
meaning.reversed: The wound begins to close; forgiveness and release.

meaning.upright: Rest and retreat; recovery is part of the campaign.
meaning.reversed: Restlessness prevents healing; stillness is not weakness.

meaning.upright: A victory that costs more than it wins; conflict leaves everyone smaller.
meaning.reversed: The urge to make amends; laying down the sword.

meaning.upright: A quiet passage from rough water toward calm; moving on.
meaning.reversed: Baggage keeps the boat in the shallows; finish what holds you.

meaning.upright: Cleverness and stealth; someone acts in the shadows — perhaps you.
meaning.reversed: A conscience stirs; secrets seek daylight.

meaning.upright: Bound by thoughts more than by ropes; the way out is closer than it feels.
meaning.reversed: The bindings loosen; a new perspective frees you.

meaning.upright: Night worries multiply in the dark; anxiety magnifies what is small.
meaning.reversed: Dawn after a long night; fears faced and shrinking.

meaning.upright: A painful ending, complete and final; the worst is over.
meaning.reversed: Rising from the ground; recovery after collapse.

meaning.upright: Alert and curious, with new ideas and sharp questions.
meaning.reversed: Words outrun thought; gossip and haste mislead.

meaning.upright: Charging at full speed toward a goal; ambition and directness.
meaning.reversed: Recklessness and aggression; a charge without a plan.

meaning.upright: Clear-eyed and independent; honesty spoken with grace.
meaning.reversed: Sharpness turns to bitterness; cold words wound.

meaning.upright: Intellectual authority and fair judgement; truth as principle.
meaning.reversed: Logic without heart; power used to control.

meaning.upright: A seed of prosperity is placed in your hand; a tangible new beginning.
meaning.reversed: An opportunity slips or was poorly planned; check the soil.

meaning.upright: Juggling priorities with grace; balance is a dance, not a pose.
meaning.reversed: Too many balls in the air; something must be set down.

meaning.upright: Skilled work recognised; collaboration builds what one cannot alone.
meaning.reversed: Discord in the workshop; craft suffers without teamwork.

meaning.upright: Holding tight to what you have; security, but also stiffness.
meaning.reversed: The grip loosens; generosity or loss, depending on the hand.

meaning.upright: Hardship and cold; help is nearer than the lit window suggests.
meaning.reversed: Recovery begins; the door was open all along.

meaning.upright: Generosity flows; giving and receiving find their balance.
meaning.reversed: Gifts with strings; debt or one-sided exchange.

meaning.upright: Patient tending; the harvest is not yet, but it grows.
meaning.reversed: Impatience with slow returns; ask whether to keep investing.

meaning.upright: Diligent practice toward mastery; one careful piece at a time.
meaning.reversed: Perfectionism or dull repetition; remember why you began.

meaning.upright: Abundance earned by your own hands; enjoy the garden.
meaning.reversed: Overwork for appearances; luxury without leisure.

meaning.upright: Legacy and lasting wealth; family and tradition stand firm.
meaning.reversed: Disputes over inheritance or values; what lasts is not only money.

meaning.upright: A studious beginning; a new goal takes practical shape.
meaning.reversed: Distraction delays progress; make the plan concrete.

meaning.upright: Steady, methodical effort; reliability is its own reward.
meaning.reversed: Routine turns to rut; stagnation dressed as diligence.

meaning.upright: Nurturing practicality; comfort and care built with skill.
meaning.reversed: Care for others crowds out care for self; restore balance.

meaning.upright: Material mastery and disciplined success; a secure realm.
meaning.reversed: Stubbornness and greed; wealth guarded past its usefulness.
